assumptions.choice: The 09:30 five-minute bar is the first 5-minute range bar; entries may begin on the 09:35 bar.
assumptions.reason: The feed is already five-minute data, so the bar timestamp marks the start of the 09:30–09:35 interval.

assumptions.choice: An upward breakout occurs when bar High is at or above the opening high; a downward breakout occurs when bar Low is at or below the opening low.
assumptions.reason: OHLCV bars cannot identify tick-level crossing, so High and Low provide the closest literal implementation.

assumptions.choice: Order quantity equals 1% of current broker portfolio value divided by current Close.
assumptions.reason: Total trading capital is interpreted as current account equity, converted to ETF shares at the available bar price.

assumptions.choice: A completed stop-loss blocks further entries in that same direction for the rest of that trading day.
assumptions.reason: The term 'immediately' is not measurable from five-minute OHLCV data; a stop-loss is used as the observable reversal event.

assumptions.choice: A close order is submitted when a bar timestamp is at or after 16:00 EST.
assumptions.reason: The strategy cannot execute an order at an intra-bar clock time not represented by the supplied feed.
